Mina: Drafting the internal release note for the 02:00 UTC window. Keeping it short here so ops can confirm runbook and coms can prep two versions. Paste below.

Mina: ```
Release v2.3.1-rc1 (internal rollout then public)
- Fix: memory leak in dispatcher under burst load (reduces high-concurrency OOMs)
- Improvement: KV cache heuristics tuned (approx -12% token cost on chat workloads)
- Ops: canary pin with automatic fallback to v2.2.9 if p99 latency >200ms for 10m
- Notes: no API surface changes; SDK bump expected for parity
```

Ravi: Looks good. Two small changes: (1) include exact rollback CLI for quick copy, (2) state who executes the internal pin.

Mina: Added below: 
- Rollback CLI: `./deploy rollback --to v2.2.9 --reason "p99>200ms_10m"`
- Pin executor: @Ravi will run the internal pin and monitor metrics.

Taylor: For comms: internal note can include the kernel-level explanation, public blurb must be customer-safe. Suggested public line: "Patch release to improve service stability and reduce memory errors; no action required from customers."

Ravi: Ops runbook (short):
1) T0 = 2026-03-24T02:00:00Z -> Run `./deploy pin --version v2.3.1 --scope internal --actor @Ravi`
2) Monitor health checks for 10m, watch p50/p95/p99 and error rate dashboards
3) If stable for 90m, run `./deploy pin --version v2.3.1 --scope public` (Taylor to post public blurb)
4) If p99 >200ms sustained 10m OR errors spike >3x baseline, run rollback CLI.

ops-oncall: Roster: @ops-oncall (primary), @Jordan (secondary). I'll cover 01:50-04:00 UTC. I'll open the incident channel if we hit >200ms p99. Confirmed watch.

Mina: Who posts the internal announce at T-30m? I can do it unless ops prefers to. Internal note will include the rollback snippet and the runbook steps.

Taylor: I'll draft both the internal detailed note and the concise public snippet. Internal note goes at T-30m; public goes T+90m after internal thumbs-up.

Ravi: I'll execute the internal pin at T0 and stay ready to flip or roll back. If I need to rollback I'll post the command and reason to the thread.

deploy-bot: Deploybot scheduled: window=2026-03-24T02:00:00Z, duration=30m, change-id=ch_997007, canary=true, auto-fallback=v2.2.9.

Mina: Added PR with full release copy and the two blurb variants: https://github.com/redwood-inference/release-notes/pull/425. Please review by COB.

ops-oncall: Acknowledged. Roster and monitor confirmed.

Taylor: LGTM, will attach public snippet to PR. :white_check_mark:

Ravi: Good to go from my side.

Mina: Locking this thread for prep. Ping if any late changes.
